create_TensorInfo: create a TensorInfo dataclass instance with dtype, shape, and data_offsets to represent safetensor tensor metadata
build_SafetensorsFileMetadata: build a SafetensorsFileMetadata dataclass instance from tensor names mapped to TensorInfo objects for a single safetensors file
build_SafetensorsRepoMetadata: build a SafetensorsRepoMetadata dataclass instance aggregating file metadata and weight maps for a safetensors repo
test_TensorInfo_parameter_count: test TensorInfo parameter_count auto-computation from shape using functools.reduce for scalar and multi-dimensional tensors
review_SafetensorsFileMetadata_parameter: review SafetensorsFileMetadata parameter_count aggregation that sums per-tensor parameter counts grouped by dtype
